_about: M3-CRE-659 post-import rules for Act I's crowd bodies (game/core/import/crowd_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules; ADR 0152): assets/crowd/<body>/<body>.glb, the LOD1 build of the characters' villager pipeline (assets_src/crowd/build_crowd.py). The same rules as the characters' villager folders (game/data/import/characters.json): each glTF material slot maps to <asset dir>/materials/<slot>.tres, Godot's auto LODs, no collision, and the body clips (anim/<body>_clips.tres: idle, talk, walk and its work clips) on an AnimationPlayer at the asset root. FieldNpc and VillagerLayer tint cloth and hair per person on top (NpcTints).

animations._about: As the characters' rule: the body's clip library on an AnimationPlayer at the asset root, 0.3 s default blend.
